items.title: TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER
items.summary:
TII has released Falcon-ASR, a 1.6B speech recognition model for Arabic with an Emirati focus. It reports 20.92% average WER on 6 Arabic test sets, but weights and an API are not yet available.
